title: Chair squat

steps.text: Stand in front of a chair with your feet hip-width apart.
steps.cue: Stand in front of the chair, feet hip-width.

steps.text: Reach your hips back and lower down until you lightly touch the seat.
steps.cue: Hips back. Lower until you touch the seat.

steps.text: Keep your chest up and your knees over your feet.
steps.cue: Chest up, knees over your feet.

steps.text: Stand back up and squeeze your glutes.
steps.cue: Stand up and squeeze your glutes.

mistakes: Dropping onto the chair instead of lowering under control.
regression: Use a higher seat, or put a firm cushion on the chair.
stopIf: Stop if you feel pain in your knees, hips or back.

anatomy.why: The front of the thigh and the buttocks straighten the knees and hips to lift you off the chair.

sources.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: 11.6 Appendicular muscles of the pelvic girdle and lower limbs
